  <script>
    (function () {
      const video = document.getElementById('heroVideo');
      if (!video) return;

      const reducedMotionQuery = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
      let isInViewport = true;

      function syncPlayback() {
        if (reducedMotionQuery.matches || !isInViewport || document.hidden) {
          video.pause();
        } else {
          video.play().catch(function () {
            /* Autoplay bloqueado por el navegador; se mantiene el poster */
          });
        }
      }

      /* Respetar prefers-reduced-motion */
      if (reducedMotionQuery.matches) {
        video.removeAttribute('autoplay');
        video.pause();
      }

      if (typeof reducedMotionQuery.addEventListener === 'function') {
        reducedMotionQuery.addEventListener('change', syncPlayback);
      }

      /* Pausar fuera del viewport */
      if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
        const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
          function (entries) {
            entries.forEach(function (entry) {
              isInViewport = entry.isIntersecting;
              syncPlayback();
            });
          },
          { threshold: 0.1 }
        );
        observer.observe(video);
      }

      /* Pausar cuando la pestaña no está visible */
      document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', syncPlayback);
    })();

    /* Header fijo: alterna entre logo completo e Isotipo al hacer scroll */
    (function () {
      const header = document.getElementById('siteHeader');
      if (!header) return;

      function syncHeaderOnScroll() {
        header.classList.toggle('is-scrolled', window.scrollY > 36);
      }

      window.addEventListener('scroll', syncHeaderOnScroll, { passive: true });
      syncHeaderOnScroll();
    })();

    /* Carrusel de Tipologías (2 en 2 con Scroll Snap + flechas) */
    (function () {
      const track = document.getElementById('typologiesTrack');
      const prevBtn = document.getElementById('typologiesPrevBtn');
      const nextBtn = document.getElementById('typologiesNextBtn');
      const stepIndicators = document.querySelectorAll('[data-step-indicator]');

      if (!track || !prevBtn || !nextBtn) return;

      const cards = Array.from(track.querySelectorAll('.typology-card'));

      function getStepWidth() {
        if (cards.length < 2) return track.clientWidth;
        const firstRect = cards[0].getBoundingClientRect();
        const secondRect = cards[1].getBoundingClientRect();
        const singleAdvance = secondRect.left - firstRect.left;
        /* En escritorio avanza de 2 en 2 tarjetas; en móvil de 1 en 1 */
        return window.innerWidth > 768 ? singleAdvance * 2 : singleAdvance;
      }

      function updateCarouselUI() {
        const maxScroll = track.scrollWidth - track.clientWidth;
        const currentScroll = track.scrollLeft;
        const isAtSecondPair = currentScroll > maxScroll * 0.45;

        stepIndicators.forEach(function (el) {
          const idx = Number(el.getAttribute('data-step-indicator'));
          const active = isAtSecondPair ? idx >= 2 : idx < 2;
          el.classList.toggle('is-active', active);
        });
      }

      prevBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        track.scrollBy({ left: -getStepWidth(), behavior: 'smooth' });
      });

      nextBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        track.scrollBy({ left: getStepWidth(), behavior: 'smooth' });
      });

      /* Sincronización nativa con scrollsnapchange o fallback con scroll */
      if ('onscrollsnapchange' in HTMLElement.prototype) {
        track.addEventListener('scrollsnapchange', updateCarouselUI);
      }
      track.addEventListener('scroll', updateCarouselUI, { passive: true });
      window.addEventListener('resize', updateCarouselUI);
      updateCarouselUI();
    })();

    /* Galería de Espacios (Centrada con peek lateral + miniaturas debajo) */
    (function () {
      const track = document.getElementById('spacesTrack');
      const activeNameEl = document.getElementById('spacesActiveName');
      const activeDescEl = document.getElementById('spacesActiveDesc');
      const thumbBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.spaces-thumb-btn[data-space-target]');
      const navBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.spaces-nav-item[data-space-target]');

      if (!track) return;

      const realSlides = Array.from(
        track.querySelectorAll('.spaces-slide:not([data-space-clone])')
      );
      const allSlides = Array.from(track.querySelectorAll('.spaces-slide'));

      function centerSlide(slideEl, smooth) {
        if (!slideEl) return;
        const trackRect = track.getBoundingClientRect();
        const slideRect = slideEl.getBoundingClientRect();
        const offset =
          slideRect.left -
          trackRect.left +
          track.scrollLeft -
          (trackRect.width - slideRect.width) / 2;

        track.scrollTo({
          left: offset,
          behavior: smooth ? 'smooth' : 'instant'
        });
      }

      function setActiveSpace(index) {
        const targetSlide = realSlides[index];
        if (!targetSlide) return;

        allSlides.forEach(function (s) {
          s.classList.toggle('is-snapped', s === targetSlide);
        });

        if (activeNameEl) {
          activeNameEl.textContent = targetSlide.getAttribute('data-space-title') || '';
        }
        if (activeDescEl) {
          activeDescEl.textContent = targetSlide.getAttribute('data-space-desc') || '';
        }

        thumbBtns.forEach(function (btn) {
          const isMatch = Number(btn.getAttribute('data-space-target')) === index;
          btn.classList.toggle('is-active', isMatch);
          if (isMatch) {
            btn.setAttribute('aria-current', 'true');
          } else {
            btn.removeAttribute('aria-current');
          }
        });

        const activeTitle = targetSlide.getAttribute('data-space-title') || '';
        navBtns.forEach(function (btn) {
          const btnGroup = btn.getAttribute('data-space-group');
          const isMatch = btnGroup
            ? btnGroup === activeTitle
            : Number(btn.getAttribute('data-space-target')) === index;
          btn.classList.toggle('is-active', isMatch);
        });
      }

      function goToSpace(index, smooth) {
        const targetSlide = realSlides[index];
        if (!targetSlide) return;
        setActiveSpace(index);
        centerSlide(targetSlide, smooth !== false);
      }

      /* Eventos en miniaturas y lista superior */
      thumbBtns.forEach(function (btn) {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
          const idx = Number(btn.getAttribute('data-space-target'));
          goToSpace(idx, true);
        });
      });

      navBtns.forEach(function (btn) {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
          const idx = Number(btn.getAttribute('data-space-target'));
          goToSpace(idx, true);
        });
      });

      /* Clic en las fotos laterales (peek) para centrarlas */
      allSlides.forEach(function (slide) {
        slide.addEventListener('click', function () {
          const idx = Number(slide.getAttribute('data-space-index'));
          goToSpace(idx, true);
        });
      });

      /* Detectar cuál slide está en el centro al hacer scroll/swipe */
      let scrollTimer = null;
      track.addEventListener(
        'scroll',
        function () {
          if (scrollTimer) cancelAnimationFrame(scrollTimer);
          scrollTimer = requestAnimationFrame(function () {
            const trackCenter = track.getBoundingClientRect().left + track.clientWidth / 2;
            let closestSlide = realSlides[0];
            let minDistance = Infinity;

            allSlides.forEach(function (slide) {
              const rect = slide.getBoundingClientRect();
              const slideCenter = rect.left + rect.width / 2;
              const dist = Math.abs(slideCenter - trackCenter);
              if (dist < minDistance) {
                minDistance = dist;
                closestSlide = slide;
              }
            });

            if (closestSlide) {
              const idx = Number(closestSlide.getAttribute('data-space-index'));
              setActiveSpace(idx);
            }
          });
        },
        { passive: true }
      );

      /* Posicionar inicialmente en el primer espacio real (Living) dejando ver Terraza a la izquierda y Cocina a la derecha */
      window.addEventListener('load', function () {
        centerSlide(realSlides[0], false);
      });
      requestAnimationFrame(function () {
        centerSlide(realSlides[0], false);
      });
    })();

    /* Acordeón exclusivo de Terminaciones Boutique (siempre 1 abierto) */
    (function () {
      const accordion = document.getElementById('finishesAccordion');
      if (!accordion) return;

      const items = Array.from(accordion.querySelectorAll('details.finish-item'));

      items.forEach(function (item) {
        const summary = item.querySelector('summary');
        if (summary) {
          /* Si el usuario presiona el ítem que ya está abierto, mantenerlo abierto para que siempre haya 1 visible */
          summary.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            if (item.open) {
              e.preventDefault();
            }
          });
        }

        item.addEventListener('toggle', function () {
          if (item.open) {
            /* Cerrar cualquier otro ítem en navegadores sin soporte nativo de details[name] */
            items.forEach(function (other) {
              if (other !== item && other.open) {
                other.open = false;
              }
            });
          }
        });
      });
    })();

    /* Puente entre el formulario visual #azHeroForm y el Formulario Nativo de Elementor Pro (guarda en Submissions y envía Email) */
    (function () {
      const heroForm = document.getElementById('azHeroForm');
      const submitBtn = document.getElementById('azHeroSubmitBtn');
      const feedbackEl = document.getElementById('azFormFeedback');
      if (!heroForm) return;

      function showFeedback(msg, isError) {
        if (!feedbackEl) return;
        feedbackEl.textContent = msg;
        feedbackEl.className = 'az-form-feedback is-visible ' + (isError ? 'is-error' : 'is-success');
      }

      heroForm.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        const elForm = document.querySelector('.elementor-widget-form form.elementor-form');
        const origText = submitBtn ? submitBtn.textContent : 'Quiero mi cotización';
        if (submitBtn) {
          submitBtn.disabled = true;
          submitBtn.textContent = 'Enviando...';
        }
        if (feedbackEl) {
          feedbackEl.className = 'az-form-feedback';
        }

        const fields = ['nombre', 'apellido', 'rut', 'telefono', 'correo', 'renta'];

        if (elForm) {
          fields.forEach(function (name) {
            const src = heroForm.elements[name];
            const dst = elForm.querySelector('[name="form_fields[' + name + ']"]');
            if (src && dst) {
              dst.value = src.value;
              dst.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
              dst.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
            }
          });

          const ajaxUrl =
            (window.ElementorProFrontendConfig && window.ElementorProFrontendConfig.ajaxurl) ||
            '/wp-admin/admin-ajax.php';

          const formData = new FormData(elForm);
          formData.set('action', 'elementor_pro_forms_send_form');
          formData.set('referrer', window.location.href);

          fetch(ajaxUrl, {
            method: 'POST',
            body: formData
          })
            .then(function (res) {
              return res.json();
            })
            .then(function (data) {
              if (submitBtn) {
                submitBtn.disabled = false;
                submitBtn.textContent = origText;
              }
              if (data && data.success) {
                showFeedback(
                  (data.data && data.data.message) ||
                    '¡Gracias! Hemos recibido tus datos y te contactaremos a la brevedad.',
                  false
                );
                heroForm.reset();
              } else {
                const errMsg =
                  (data && data.data && data.data.message) ||
                  'Ocurrió un problema al enviar tus datos. Por favor intenta nuevamente.';
                showFeedback(errMsg, true);
              }
            })
            .catch(function () {
              if (submitBtn) {
                submitBtn.disabled = false;
                submitBtn.textContent = origText;
              }
              showFeedback(
                'Ocurrió un problema de conexión. Por favor intenta nuevamente.',
                true
              );
            });
        }
      });
    })();
  </script>
